results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.title: Last Mile Operations Manager
results.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: We operate autonomous delivery vehicles in the UAE. This role owns whether those deliveries actually land — on time, without failure, without a complaint. Once a customer is live and vehicles are on the road, the fulfilment flow is yours: order intake, dispatch, pickup, driving, customer handover. You will take it apart, make it measurable, watch it in real time, and drive the fixes. You will lead a team of 2–3. Expect to firefight. Early-stage operations break in ways nobody has documented yet, and you will need to contain problems fast, often on incomplete information. But every incident should leave behind a standard, a monitor, or a fix — we will judge you on how fast you contain today’s problem, and on how few of them you are still containing three months in. What You’ll Own On-time delivery rate, fulfilment success rate, vehicle utilisation, exception rate and MTTR — the numbers this role is measured on. Fulfilment standards and SOPs that our field and service teams run on. Real-time monitoring and the escalation model — with a documented root cause for every major failure. Turning field problems into prioritised, evidence-backed asks for product and engineering — and following through until the metric moves. What You’ll Need Essential 3–5 years in last-mile delivery, on-demand logistics, ride-hailing, quick commerce or fleet operations. Proven ability to build process, not just run it — you have taken a messy operation, decomposed it, and made it repeatable by others. This matters more to us than years of management. A metric you personally moved , and the story of how. SQL and BI — you pull and cut your own data rather than queuing behind an analyst. Skilled with AI tools — you build your own dashboards, analyses or prototypes instead of waiting on someone else. A track record of driving fixes through teams you don’t manage . Hands-on operating experience in the UAE or wider GCC . Fluent English; based in Abu Dhabi or ready to relocate. Preferred Autonomous vehicle, delivery robot or teleoperation background. Arabic. Team leadership experience. Zero-to-one market launch. What We Offer Competitive package benchmarked to the UAE market. Company-provided AI tool subscriptions. Visa sponsored. Ownership of UAE fulfilment performance in a business building autonomous delivery operations from zero — very few companies in the region are doing this — with a team of 2–3 from day one. This is an early-stage business: frequent problems, fast pace, processes still being written. If that is the environment you do your best work in, this role will give you more of it than most. results.title: Senior Director: Mobility Planner
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 20+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments. We are seeking a Senior Director - Event Mobility Planning to join JASARA PMC. The Senior Director, Event Mobility Planning is accountable for establishing and leading the integrated mobility planning capability for major events, festivals, sporting competitions and entertainment activations across the city program. The role ensures the safe, efficient and coordinated movement of guests, athletes, performers, VIPs, workforce, volunteers, logistics vehicles, emergency services and public transport users across venues, districts and transport modes. The position acts as the City Operations mobility lead and coordination authority for major events. It develops citywide standards, demand forecasts, event mobility plans, traffic management plans and operational readiness arrangements particularly for city's major events programme in 2028, while maintaining clear boundaries with venue and asset operators that remain accountable for operations within their controlled areas. results.title: Operations Manager – Long-Term Rentals
results.description: Location: Dubai, UAE Department: Long-Term Rentals (LTR) Employment Type: Full-time About The Role We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager – Long-Term Rentals to oversee the overall performance of our LTR function. The role will be responsible for coordinating and managing multiple teams, including Sales, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and other supporting functions , ensuring that all departments work together effectively to achieve business objectives. The ideal candidate will be a strong people leader with excellent commercial and operational understanding, capable of driving performance, improving processes, and ensuring smooth day-to-day functioning of the LTR business. Key Responsibilities Oversee the overall performance and day-to-day functioning of the LTR business. Lead and coordinate teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and other relevant functions. Set clear KPIs and ensure teams achieve their performance and business targets. Monitor revenue, costs, fleet utilisation, customer satisfaction, and overall operational efficiency. Work closely with department leads to identify issues, improve processes, and ensure smooth cross-functional coordination. Drive customer acquisition, retention, and overall service quality. Monitor financial and operational performance and identify opportunities for cost optimisation and revenue growth. Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution of cross-functional and customer-related issues. Prepare and present regular performance reports and updates to senior management. Lead, motivate, and develop teams while maintaining a strong culture of accountability and performance. Identify opportunities to improve processes, productivity, and overall business efficiency. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Management, or a related field. 6–8+ years of relevant experience in operations, car rental, mobility, automotive, fleet management, or a similar industry. Proven experience managing multiple teams or functions. Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. Strong commercial and analytical mindset with the ability to understand business performance and KPIs. Experience in managing budgets, costs, revenue, and operational performance. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and make effective decisions. UAE experience in car rental, mobility, automotive, or fleet management is highly preferred.

results.title: Director of Operations - Saudi Arabia AOC (GACA)
results.description: Beond is the world's first premium leisure airline, flying an all-lie-flat Airbus fleet, and is standing up new Air Operator Certificates in Bahrain (BCAA) and Saudi Arabia (GACA). We are seeking a Director of Operations for our Saudi Arabia AOC (General Authority of Civil Aviation), based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Director of Operations is appointed by, and reports to, the Accountable Executive, and is responsible for: Exercise operational control and accountability for the conduct of flight operations under the AOC Own the operations manual, ensure ops-specifications compliance and set operational standards Oversee flight dispatch, flight-time limitations and flight-crew standards Serve as the operational interface with GACA for approvals, audits and findings Embed the SMS within operations Requirements This is a required management position under GACAR Part 121.45. The post is full-time and the successful candidate must be acceptable to GACA (the President) based on experience, competence and knowledge, with a full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)). Mandatory Hold an Airline Transport Pilot (ATP) certificate (GACAR 121.49(a)(1)) At least 3 years' supervisory/managerial experience within the last 6 years exercising operational control over Part 121-similar operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(2)) At least 3 years' experience within the past 6 years as PIC of a Part 121 aircraft — for a first-time Director of Operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(3)) Full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual; must be acceptable to GACA (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)) Desirable Airbus A320/A321 experience Existing GACA regulatory relationships and new-AOC experience Fluent English; Arabic advantageous Benefits A competitive package with relocation support where applicable, and the opportunity to build a premium airline certificate from the ground up as part of a fast-growing multi-AOC group. If you do not receive a response from us within 4 weeks of submitting your application, please consider your application to be unsuccessful due to the high volume of applications we receive.

results.title: Manager Logistics Performance
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Role Summary This role owns the commercial and performance engine behind talabat UAE's operations. You'll be the person who understands how the business actually ticks, where margin is made or lost, which levers move the numbers, and what trade-offs leadership is really weighing. You'll own the operational commercials and KPI performance, drive the optimization work that improves efficiency and experience, and turn analysis into decisions. It's a role for someone equally comfortable in a model and in a room full of directors, someone who can read the data and stand their ground on what it means . What's on your plate? Commercial & P&L Ownership for Operations Own the commercials behind UAE operations, cost-per-order, rider cost, and the efficiency metrics that drive the operational P&L. Track budget vs. actuals, protect riders and 3pls earnings, and give leadership clear, data-backed trade-offs between cost, growth, and customer experience. You're the person who can explain why the numbers moved, not just that they did. Performance Management Own the UAE operational KPI stack, from forecast to actuals. Anticipate performance gaps before they hit the P&L and drive the interventions that close them. Run the reporting and executive reviews that keep leadership decision-ready. Operational Optimization Drive the optimization agenda across the network: rider economics and staffing efficiency, vendor and coverage performance, area-level improvements. Find where the operation leaks cost or time, size the opportunity, and lead the fix, balancing efficiency against rider earnings and customer experience. Data, Modeling & Insight Be genuinely good with data, able to interrogate complex models, understand what's driving them, and pressure-test assumptions rather than take outputs at face value. Build the analyses and dashboards that make decisions faster, and translate complexity into a clear "so what." SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau are a strong plus; the non-negotiable is analytical judgment. Strategic Projects & Senior Stakeholder Leadership Lead cross-functional, high-impact projects that shape UAE operations. Build the business case, run the pilot, scale what works. Throughout, work directly with senior leadership, and hold your own with directors and VPs, defending a recommendation with evidence and staying credible under challenge. What you own vs. influence: You own the operational commercials, the performance KPI stack, and the delivery of your optimization projects. You influence the ops, commercial, and product teams whose execution moves those numbers, through insight, credibility, and stakeholder trust rather than direct authority. Qualifications What did we order? At least 4 years in operations, commercial, strategy, or consulting, ideally in a marketplace, logistics, or Q-commerce environment. Commercial instinct: you understand how a business makes money and which levers actually move it. Strong data literacy, comfortable working with complex data and models, interrogating assumptions, and drawing the right conclusion. You don't need to be handed the answer. Executive presence: able to engage, challenge, and stand your ground with senior stakeholders including directors and VPs. Financial modeling and P&L fluency, you can read a model, break it, and explain it. SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau a strong plus, not a requirement. Bias for ownership and follow-through, you close the loop rather than hand off the problem. Readiness to grow into people leadership (1–2 reports over time).

results.title: Intelligent Transportation Systems Manager
results.description: We are currently seeking ITS professionals for an exciting opportunity within a major Traffic Operations / Intelligent Transport Systems environment in the Middle East . We’re particularly interested in professionals with experience across Traffic Operations Management, ITS, RMC and Tunnel Control Centre operations, SCATS, traffic engineering, operational performance, data analysis, incident management and major-event traffic planning . Job Purpose : Responsible for the monitoring and reporting on the operational performance of the Roads Management Centre (RMC) and Tunnels Control Centres and for leading the analysis and preparation of operational improvement strategies. Manage the monthly performance reporting of the RMC and Tunnels Operations and the ad-hoc reporting required to support major incidents and special events Reponsibilities: Close management of the subcontractors that are providing the SCATS and traffic engineering support for RMC and Tunnels to ensure on-road performance is optimized and aligned with the performance measures being implemented for corridor performance and incident management. Manage the production and review of the monthly performance reports for RMC and Tunnels operations ensuring the deadlines and quality standards are met. Coordinate ad-hoc major incident and special event reporting and lead the lessons learned and best practice assessments for such reports Lead the data and process analysis activities to develop and deliver a traffic engineering improvements plan that details SCATS traffic signal management improvements and incident and event management improvements. Manage the recording and response to customer complaints relating to the RMC and Tunnels operations, ensuring responses and actions are performed within the Service Level Agreement (SLA) timings. Lead the root cause analysis of complaints. Focal point for special event coordination with key stakeholders such as Ministry of Interior, Supreme Committee for Delivery and Legacy and the Ministry of Transport.s Manage the traffic response plan preparation for special events and the necessary configuration of the traffic management systems to support the response plans. Analyze the configuration and effectiveness of existing traffic management response plans and develop and deliver a program of improvements, managing traffic simulation modelling, data analysis and traffic engineering activities accordingly. Education and Experience : Bachelor's degree in Transportation Planning, Computer Science or similar Minimum of 10 years’ experience in the Transportation Planning and Management space with a proven track record in managing, ideally in the Middle East region Expertise with Traffic Modelling systems and Data Analysis tools. Experience in leading traffic studies and major event traffic management planning. Experience with delivering management level reporting and meeting contractual deadlines.

results.title: Country Operations Manager
results.description: About noon We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Country Manager, Kuwait Supermall who can help us move even faster. noon’s mission: Every door, every day. What you'll do: Team noon has some of the fastest, smartest, and hardest-working people we've encountered. With a young, aggressive, and talented team, we're driving major missions forward. The Country Manager will lead the end-to-end performance of Supermall operations in Kuwait, with accountability across fulfilment, inventory, store operations, and last-mile delivery. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong field execution, analytical decision-making, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced quick-commerce environment. Lead overall country operations and ensure consistent execution across the operating network. Translate regional direction into operating plans, capacity requirements, workforce plans, and performance targets. Lead end-to-end operations across inbound receiving, inventory, replenishment, picking, packing, dispatch, and last-mile delivery. Lead delivery operations and service partners against capacity, attendance, service-level, and quality requirements. Demonstrated ownership of a country, region, or significant operating unit, including operational performance and large frontline teams. Proven experience establishing and stabilizing multi-site operations in a fast-paced environment. Strong understanding of dark-store operations, inventory management, workforce planning, last-mile delivery, and 3PL/vendor management. Who will excel? We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters. You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action. We need people with the courage to be fiercely original. noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.
